name: Pequossette Summer Recreation Program
description_short: A city-run summer day camp for children entering kindergarten through 8th grade, held at Lowell Elementary School. Campers are grouped by grade, and the summer includes weekly field trips and special events such as Color Wars.
activities: Field trips (Franklin Park Zoo, Canobie Lake Park, Museum of Science, Urban Air/APEX)
refund_policy_summary: If you cancel more than 7 days before a session starts, you get a refund or household credit minus a cancellation fee per child, per week: $75 for residents, $88.50 for non-residents. If you cancel 7 days or less before the start, or after the session begins, there is no refund unless there is a documented medical withdrawal.

warnings: The source shows only the 2026 season, which is already over (today is 2026-10-13). Dates and prices for 2027 are not published here and may change.
Session prices are the resident rates. Non-residents pay $295 per week ($250 for the 4-day Week 2).
Week 1 (June 22–26, 2026) was cancelled and is not included. Camp started June 29.
The page lists Extended Day hours as '3:30 AM – 5:30 PM', which is almost certainly a typo for 3:30 PM.
The End of Summer Program weeks are separate programs: a Playground Program for grades K–4 and a Field Trip Program for grades 4–8. Their prices are not listed.
Early drop-off (7:30–8:30 AM) costs an extra $35 resident / $50 non-resident per week. Extended day costs an extra $60 resident / $80 non-resident per week.
